item.title: كيف تكمل صلاتك إذا فاتتك ركعة أو أكثر مع الإمام؟...
item.author: clubquran_ensias
item.content:encoded: كيف تكمل صلاتك إذا فاتتك ركعة أو أكثر مع الإمام؟ كثيرا ما ندرك الإمام وقد فاتنا جزء من الصلاة، ونحتار في تفاصيل إتمامها، متى نكبر للقيام، وهل نتابع الإمام في سجود السهو أم لا. في هذا المنشور، لخصنا لكم أهم أحكام "المسبوق" في الفقه المالكي بأسلوب مبسط، معتمدين على القاعدة الذهبية: "قاضٍ في الأقوال، بانٍ في الأفعال"، وتفصيل أحكام الدخول والمتابعة، وسجود السهو، والتكبير عند القيام لإتمام الصلاة. تصفح الصور لمعرفة الخلاصة الفقهية والأدلة النبوية. المصادر والمراجع المعتمدة: كتاب "الدر الثمين والمورد المعين" (شرح أرجوزة ابن عاشر) للشيخ ميارة المالكي. كتاب "التوضيح" للشيخ خليل بن إسحاق (في تفصيل أحكام المسبوق والجمع بين الأحاديث). احفظ المنشور للرجوع إليه وقت الحاجة، وشاركه مع غيرك لتعم الفائدة، فالدال على الخير كفاعله. #فقه_مالكي #أحكام_الصلاة #ابن_عاشر #فقه_العبادات

item.title: How does a humanoid robot actually work? ...
item.author: ensias_neurodynamics_club
item.content:encoded: How does a humanoid robot actually work? It looks human. It moves like us. But what’s happening behind the scenes? From sensors and actuators to AI, balance, motion control, and learning, a humanoid robot is essentially a continuous loop: Perceive → Decide → Act → Adapt. In this carousel, we break down the key systems that allow humanoid robots to sense their environment, control their movements, maintain balance, interact with objects, and continuously improve. Swipe through to understand the technology behind the motion. The future of robotics starts with understanding how machines learn to move. #Robotics #HumanoidRobots #ArtificialIntelligence #AI #MachineLearning #RoboticsEngineering #Technology #FutureTech #Engineering #NeuroDynamics

item.title: Fauvism can be seen as an extreme extension of the post-impressionism of Van Gogh combined with the neo-impressionism of...
item.author: house.of.arts.ensias
item.content:encoded: Fauvism can be seen as an extreme extension of the post-impressionism of Van Gogh combined with the neo-impressionism of Seurat. The influences of these earlier movements inspired Matisse and his followers to reject traditional three-dimensional space and instead use flat areas or patches of colour to create a new pictorial space. Fauvism can also be seen as a form of expressionism in its use of brilliant colors and spontaneous brushwork. It has often been compared to German expressionism, which emerged at around the same time and was also inspired by the developments of post-impressionism. Although one of the first avant-garde modernist movements of the twentieth century and one of the first styles to make a move towards abstraction, for many of the artists who adopted a fauvist approach it became a transitional stepping stone for future developments in their style. By 1908 most of the main artists in the group had moved away from the expressive emotionalism of fauvism. A renewed interest in post-impressionist artist Paul Cézanne and the analytical approach he took to painting landscapes, people and objects inspired many artists to embrace order and structure instead. One–time fauvist Georges Braque went on to develop cubism along with Pablo Picasso while one of fauvism’s founders André Derain adopted a more conventional neoclassical style. Henri Matisse however continued to use the distinctive fauvist traits of bright emotive colours, simple shapes and painterly mark-making throughout his career. Credits to: Tate & ArtDaily magazine. #Art #Fauvism #HOA #HouseOfArts #Paintings
